purpose: Measure how much of the already observed EXP201/202 development effect remains after removing all four known public twins.
disclosure: The aggregate non-twin scores were manually inspected before this scripted audit was frozen. This is therefore explicitly post-hoc sensitivity analysis, not preregistration and not confirmatory evidence.

fixed_policies.EXP190: translation min8 forward plus translation min3 reverse
fixed_policies.EXP201: flow k32 alpha .50 min8 forward plus flow k16 alpha .25 min3 reverse
fixed_policies.EXP195: translation min8 forward plus fixed q75 base/gap reverse policy

exclusion: Remove exactly the four PUBLIC_TWINS defined by build_frozen_confirmation_results.py; require exactly 10 remaining movies per direction.
guard: Results cannot alter EXP192, EXP201 or EXP202 and cannot replace the frozen 175-movie untouched confirmation.
